description: Code accompanying Kritos & Perna (2026), "Tidally Induced Coda: Double Transients from Black Hole–Star Binary Encounters with Massive Black Holes": a SpaceHub-based post-Newtonian three-body code, campaign scripts, and the analysis notebooks that reproduce the paper's figures from the archived simulation data.
